notes: Kept re-running unprotected R&D into the same top card (T1, T2 hitting Behold! three times for 4 tags and 0 credits, T3 five runs, T6 hitting Increased Drop Rates four times for 4 tags, T7). It then spent T8-T12 clicking credits and removing tags while a broke Corp slow-advanced Stoke the Embers and Post-Truth Dividend in Server 1, which it never ran; Tremolo was the only install all game.

Solid Hoshiko game with HQ steals via Utae/Rising Tide on Hafrun (T4, T6), a Server 4 steal through Diviner (T7) and a Devil Charm R&D push. Minor issues were running the second naked remote into another Urtica Cipher on T3 and facechecking Ivik on T4 for 2 net.

Good T1 steal of Next Big Thing through Klevetnik with Gauss, and steady Server 1 pressure won it. But T5-T7 were pure credit clicking up to 19 credits with 5 cards and no runs or installs, T2's second R&D run repeated the same top card, and it left Hype Machine in Server 4 untrashed on T9.

Efficient HQ/Archives pressure with Utae on Diviner and Rising Tide, winning T9 with two Sericulture steals on T4. On T1 it ran R&D with 0 credits into unrezzed ice (Hafrun ETR), and T7 was all credit clicks with 6 credits when an HQ run was affordable.

On T1 it facechecked HQ at 0 credits (Ping tag), then on T2 ran into the known Ping again with 0 credits for nothing. The T7 Doomscroll facecheck on Server 1 cost the whole grip, but later Server 1 runs (T9, and Laser Pointer on T11) stole Post-Truth Dividend and Stoke the Embers to win; it often sat on tags against a tag-punishment Corp.

It made four single-access R&D runs a turn into the same top card (T2, T4, T5) and then clicked credits for whole turns (T6-T8, T10-T11, T14-T15), reaching 24 credits with nothing installed. On T9 it jacked out of Server 1 after eating Phoneutria with 16 credits, and Corp scored Project Yagi-Uda from there on T10; it won only on late Server 3/Archives steals.

Persistent R&D pressure through Vasilisa won (Remastered Edition, Kingmaking, Oracle Thinktank, Next Big Thing). But it took a tag on nearly every run and let them pile up against an Epiphany Public Trail deck, never found a way to break Vasilisa with Unity installed, and idled on credit clicks at T9-T12.

After early Server 2 steals it clicked for credits all of T5-T7, T9 and T11-T12, hoarding 39 credits without ever running HQ or R&D. On T13 and T15 it ran into F2P twice per turn, each time losing Gauss to the bounce and reinstalling it, and on T17 it made no run at all while Next Big Thing sat advanced in Server 2, which Corp scored to win on T18.

A strong T1 (Chastushka then an Archives steal of See How They Run) and a T6 double R&D steal were followed by clicking credits nearly every turn from T8 to T18, reaching 56 credits. Meanwhile Corp scored Lotus Haze (T5), Hybrid Release (T6, T11), Longevity Serum (T16) and Sisyphus Protocol (T19) from remotes it never contested, though R&D was easily passable.

After the Mitosis turn it stole Hybrid Release from Server 1 on T2, then facechecked R&D (Knowledge Seeker ETR) instead of running naked Server 2 with 2 advancements, and Corp scored Lotus Haze there on T3. Later play was sensible: a Katorga remote hit, HQ steals through Konjin, Chastushka to wipe HQ, and the win with an HQ steal of Sisyphus Protocol.

Good HQ pressure through Hafrun with Rising Tide/Abaasy stole Hybrid Release, Longevity Serum and Regenesis. On the T9 Mitosis turn it spent two clicks drawing and ran only Server 4 (stole Lotus Haze), leaving naked Server 3 with 3 advancements, and Corp scored Hybrid Release there at the start of T10; the T1 HQ facecheck into Hafrun was also wasted.

It stole Artificial Cryptocrash from Server 1 on T2 and kept up steady single-access R&D runs through Paywall. But from T8-T15 it ignored a visibly flooded HQ (Corp discarding every turn) and padded turns with credit clicks; when it finally ran HQ on T15 through Capacitor with Gauss, it found two agendas immediately.

It made repeated single-access runs on unprotected R&D into the same card (T1, T2, T5; T3 hit Esca three times to go broke; T7 hit Mavirus twice) while ignoring naked remotes (Servers 3 and 4 on T5). On T7 it skipped naked Mitosis Server 6 (Longevity Serum, scored T8), then clicked credits T8-T12 up to 21 while See How They Run was installed and advanced in Server 1 for the Corp win on T13.

The economy never got going (two Daily Casts, frequent 0-3 credits), and much of the game went to removing tags from Witch Hunt, Behold! (walked into it in Server 3 on T10) and Oppo Research. It facechecked Ping (T4 Concerto) and N-Pot (T14) on Server 1 without breakers, installed a duplicate Docklands Pass that was immediately trashed (T13), and spent T16-T17 only removing tags as Corp closed out.

Aggressive and effective: it stole Freedom of Information and Tomorrow's Headline through Doomscroll (T2, T4), Witch Hunt via Concerto (T10), and Post-Truth Dividend with Window of Opportunity for the win. The T4 Doomscroll run cost 3 cards and was risky, the T5 facecheck into Ping at 3 credits was loose, and T8 was mostly credit clicks while Stoke the Embers was advanced.

It ran unprotected R&D three or four times per turn into the same top card (T1-T5) instead of making one access and using other clicks productively. On T2 it ignored the freshly installed Server 1 card, which Corp scored as Project Yagi-Uda on T3; it won fast mainly through Server 2 and Server 1 steals (Fujii Asset Retrieval on T7).

It played very slowly against a passive Corp that only clicked credits with a flooded HQ, running empty Archives nearly every turn (T10-T16, T21-T26) while rarely paying through Grubber on HQ, where every hit found agendas. It installed Living Mural on Capacitor twice (T4, T13) but did not run R&D until T18, and spent T21-T25 at 0 credits; the game took 27 turns.

It ran R&D three or four times per turn into the same top card (T1-T4, T6-T8), wasting about half its clicks. Server 1 went uncontested while Corp scored Sericulture Expansion on T2 and again on T4, after a T3 install the Runner ignored; it won via R&D steals and a Rising Tide run on Tatu-Bola for Flower Sermon.

On T4 and again on T5 it ate both Karuna subroutines (4 net damage each time) and then jacked out before Hafrun, wasting the damage and risking a flatline; Corp scored Hybrid Release from that server on T6. Otherwise it played well: a T1 HQ steal of Fujii, a T5 Archives double steal, and the T7 win through Karuna and Hafrun for Project Yagi-Uda.

It made good remote hits through Capacitor with Gauss (Kingmaking T7, Oracle Thinktank T9) and checked Epiphany installs, winning with Artificial Cryptocrash on T15. But whole turns went to credit clicks (T6, T10, T11, T13, T14, up to 20 credits) without pressuring HQ or R&D, and it left Daily Quest in Server 2 untouched.
